No collaboration scenario is included because safe_mean has no confirmed direct calls to same-file functions (only builtins sum/len), so a collaboration test would add no behavior beyond the unit cases.
The branch scenarios intentionally exercise the same inputs as boundary cases to cover the two control-flow paths; the single if at line 5 is the only source branch.
